submission.natural_language_explanation: A token-level GPU detector: fires on the token itself whenever it is a GPU word (' GPU', ' GPUs', 'GPU' reach about 4-5x the scan max), and fires more weakly on other GPU-vocabulary tokens (' GTX', ' Radeon', ' CU' of CUDA, ' shader', the 'pu' of 'gpu', and ' compute') plus a few look-alike fragments ('pu' in Después, ' IGF', the 'uda' in 'Cuda'). It is exactly zero on everything else, including ' CPU'/' CPUs', ' RTX', ' GeForce', ' graphics', 'video card' and ordinary text, and the first token sets no floor (it is 0 unless that token is itself a GPU word).
